Name: JojaPop - Pokemon Furniture
Author: tinydipper
Description:
[center][size=5][font=Courier New][b]Want something new to collect? Need a money sink? Consider purchasing a blind box or ball from your local [/b][/font][/size][size=5][font=Impact]Jojapop[/font][/size][size=5][font=Courier New][b] shop today![/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Want specific info? Check out the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1671gdtrAgrgLu7TcQndofEeitnFhK_i_4fFEf17BFhM/edit?usp=sharing][b]item spreadsheet[/b][/url][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35850]Jojapop - Labubu[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b][u]Recommended Mods[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32562]Stack More Things [/url](Allows furniture items to stack)[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4][u]Future Plans[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Qi Gem Balls[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Festival-related balls[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Plush based on your suggestions[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Even more![/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4][u]Thanks, Credits, Notes[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS?gameId=1303]AirynS[/url], creator of the base Jojapop mod, that taught me modding via cracking it open like a clock to see the gears, and for the kind words of encouragement and wisdom.[/*]
[*]Sprites are not original art. I re-scaled and edited existing official pokemon sprites available widely, but I used the source [url=https://msikma.github.io/pokesprite/index.html]here[/url] the most. I relied heavily on the gen 7 sprites. Thank you for the sprite database, [url=https://github.com/msikma]msikma[/url]! And of course to the talented and probably underpaid original creators of the sprites. (I tried to find the names because I hate to pull a 'credit to the creator uwu'. Please share if you know!)[/*]
[*]This is a human-made mod. I like making things and learning stuff. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b][u]Feedback[/u]
[/b][/size]This mod is in its infancy, and I want your feedback! Please let me know what you think in the comments.

[b][size=4][u]Translations[/u][/size]
[/b]Translations are welcome and appreciated! The i18n framework is all set up for you. Please no AI translations or graphics.

[center][b][size=4]Pokemon Suggestions: [u]Open![/u][/size][/b]
Chime off in the comments![/center]
